gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9001 covers optical elements of any material, unmounted; heading 9002 covers mounted ones; chapter 90 note 1(e) excludes only headings 7007, 7008, 7011, 7014, 7015, 7017

rejected_alternatives.reason: applies to mounted photographic filters; mounting not stated
excluded from ch. 90 only for non-optically-worked glass; photographic filters are optical elements

missing_facts: whether the filters are mounted (9002.20.40.00 if mounted) and whether the glass is optically worked
classification.rationale: Glass photographic filters described without mounting are unmounted optical elements of heading 9001; in-force ruling H81010 classified photographic optical filters in 9001.90.90.
